description: AP, AR, banking & ERP data from Cortena FinOps in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Cortena is a finance operating system for SMB finance teams. AI agents run payables and receivables pre-accounting against your accounting system, help with bank reconciliation, and give direct access to synced ERP data — trial balances, posting history, and charts of accounts from DATEV, Exact Online, and Twinfield. With read+write access you can update Cortena invoice coding and workflow state that feeds those ERPs (prepare → confirm → commit).

This connector lets ChatGPT work with your live Cortena data using the same permissions as the web app.

Who it's for:
Finance operators, controllers, and approvers who use ChatGPT and want answers like "What invoices need my approval?", "Show overdue unpaid payables this week", "Which bank transactions are unallocated?", or "What's the DATEV trial balance for account 4400?" without switching tabs.

What you can do
- Search and inspect payables and receivables with the same filters as the Cortena workspace
- Bank reconciliation: list and inspect bank transactions, including allocation and accounting-export status
- ERP / accounting data: read synced trial balances, posting history, dimensions, and charts of accounts from DATEV, Exact Online, and Twinfield
- Check your approval and review queues
- Read Pulse dashboard metrics with deep links into filtered lists
- Browse workflows and human step types
- Upload payables (PDF, image, or XML)
- Approve, complete review, reject, or update coding via prepare → confirm → commit

Security and access
- Each user connects with their own Cortena login (OAuth)
- A tenant admin must grant MCP access per tenant
- Read-only and read + write modes are configurable on first connect
- MCP does not initiate bank/treasury payments or push accounting exports
defaultPrompt: Show overdue unpaid payables this week

positive.description: List tenants available to the connected Cortena user
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the tenants the session may access (intersection of connector allow-list, membership, and MCP access).

positive.description: Find invoices that need the user’s approval
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the workflow catalog and invoice list with workflowEligibleActor=me and workflowStepType=approval to show the approval queue.

positive.description: Show overdue unpaid payables for this week
positive.prompt: Show overdue unpaid payables this week
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a filtered payable invoice list matching overdue/unpaid criteria the user is allowed to see.

positive.description: Inspect unallocated bank transactions for reconciliation
positive.expected_behavior: Returns bank transactions filtered to unallocated / reconciliation context the user is allowed to see.

positive.prompt: Prepare to approve that invoice, show me the summary, and wait for my yes before committing.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a humanSummary and confirmationToken from approve/prepare, then commits only after explicit user confirmation.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for generic weather or chitchat
negative.prompt: What’s the weather in Amsterdam this weekend?

negative.description: Do not trigger for banking or treasury payment initiation
negative.prompt: Initiate a SEPA payment from my bank account for €12,000 to Acme.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
